title: refactor(spec)!: retire the ragPipelines collection listings no stack can declare
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiQQmi2TjBrbnC33qdD1Dhr1)_

Fixes #31380

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no skill or doc page names `ragPipelines` or `rag_pipeline` (`git grep` over `skills/` and `content/docs/` at the head: zero hits)

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 把 `ragPipelines` 从四张登记表里撤掉（spec 的复数→单数映射、引擎的集合表、metadata 插件的产物映射、runtime 的应用载荷探针），连带撤掉门禁里给它开的四行豁免。`rag_pipeline` 因此退出 `/meta` 的 URL 拼写契约：会开新命名空间的写入改为被拒（400，和 theme 退役同形；部署的 sys_metadata 里已有 rag_pipeline 行时，写门的旧命名空间豁免仍接受写入，直到这些行删光），`/meta/types` 不再把它列为可创建。
- **为什么改：** `defineStack` 从来不接受 `ragPipelines`，任何作者都写不出这个集合，四张表却都把它当成一种元数据类型，读到这些表的人或 AI 会以为平台有「RAG 管道」集合。按分诊裁定「零拉动 ⇒ 退役」。
- **风险与回滚：** 唯一的外部可见变化是 `PUT /meta/rag_pipeline/...` 在没有旧行的部署上从「存任意 JSON」变成拒绝（已有旧行的部署按旧命名空间豁免继续接受，删光后才拒）；objectstack、ui、hotcrm、gallery 里没有任何写入者，cloud 未测（座位落地前另核）。已存的旧行不改写，仍可读可删，但不再随包导出。回滚即 revert。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/meta-spelling/manifest-collection-spelling.ts`（删行本身）；`packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.meta-type-rag-pipeline-retired.ts`（给升级者的说明）；`packages/qa/dogfood/test/package-export-type-read-failure.dogfood.test.ts`（样本改法）。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs`，预期 `8 enumerations reconciled … (16 waiver rows …)`，豁免里不再有 `ragPipelines`。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ragPipelines` was listed as a metadata collection in four registries while `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema` never declared the key, so `defineStack` refused it and no stack could ever ship one. This retires every listing (ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove, triage ruling 6717949516; seat ruling in the card thread to retire the URL-contract entry with it):

- **`@objectstack/spec`** — the `ragPipelines: 'rag_pipeline'` row leaves `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR` (so also `SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL` and the regenerated `META_URL_TO_SINGULAR`). `rag_pipeline` leaves the `/meta` URL-spelling contract exactly as `theme` did (commit 35ad101bc): `PUT /meta/rag_pipeline/:name` now gets the unrecognised-type refusal (`400 INVALID_REQUEST`) instead of the no-schema branch that stored any JSON — unless the deployment's `sys_metadata` already holds `rag_pipeline` rows, in which case the write door's legacy-namespace exemption keeps accepting writes until those rows are deleted — and `GET /meta/types` stops advertising it as creatable. Upgraders get the D3 semantic entry `meta-type-rag-pipeline-retired` plus a step-18 rationale fragment. No `retiredKey()` tombstone (the key is on no schema) and no D2 conversion (no stack source can hold it).
- **`@objectstack/objectql`** — out of `METADATA_ARRAY_KEYS`.
- **`@objectstack/metadata`** — out of `ARTIFACT_FIELD_TO_TYPE`.
- **`@objectstack/runtime`** — out of the `APP_CATEGORY_KEYS` probe.
- **`scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs`** — the four `ragPipelines` waiver rows and the header note go; the gate now holds every map to the schema with no exception for it, which is the tree-wide guard against the row coming back (reverse-verified below).
- **`ObjectStackDefinitionSchema`** — a `guidance` entry prescribes the never-declared `ragPipelines` key.
- **Tests** — the specimens that used `rag_pipeline` move to a still-present kind and keep their intent: the no-static-entry write control in `objectql/protocol-meta.test.ts` is now `connector`; `rag_pipeline` joins `theme` on the refused/withdrawn side in `metadata-url-spelling.test.ts`, `protocol.unrecognised-meta-type.test.ts`, `protocol.meta-types-mint-door-agreement.test.ts` and a new `CHANGED BEHAVIOUR` case in `protocol-meta.test.ts`.
- **Dogfood** — `package-export-type-read-failure` used `rag_pipeline` as the showcase's one exportable type its live vocabulary does not list. After this change no such type exists on the showcase (measured: every exportable plural folds to a listed type), so case 4 now drops `connector` from `getMetaTypes` for one leg beside the failed read, and asserts the real vocabulary does list it.

## Acceptance notes

- **cloud producer census: NOT MEASURED** (repo not readable from this session). objectstack, `ui/`, hotcrm and gallery have no writer of `rag_pipeline`. The seat checks cloud before landing.
- **Export door:** `GET /packages/:id/export` and `GET /packages/export` build their collections from `PLURAL_TO_SINGULAR`, so a legacy `rag_pipeline` row a deployment wrote through the old `/meta` door is no longer exported (it stays readable and deletable through `/meta`). A customization-pair install refuses an older export carrying a non-empty `ragPipelines` array, naming the key; an empty one is skipped.
- **Stack prescription:** `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema`'s `guidance` now answers `ragPipelines` with a prescription instead of the generic unrecognized-key fallback (pinned in `stack-top-level-strict.test.ts`).
- **Two edited metadata-protocol suites** gained the module-top `import '@objectstack/lint'` that `check:test-source-alias` asks of an edited test whose source reaches that dynamic import.
- Out of bounds and unchanged: `docs/adr/0048-…` still says `rag_pipeline` "cannot be declared through `defineStack`", which stays true; CHANGELOGs are history.

## Verification

All readings on head `0f4f7ccc` (the head after it only marks the changeset summary breaking) (branch merged with `origin/main` at `ae816c40b`; full `pnpm build` green after the merge).

- **Unit suites** (`pnpm --filter PKG test` / `typecheck`, all exit 0): spec 822 files / 25980 tests; metadata-protocol 326 files / 22562 tests; objectql 569 / 11547; metadata 70 / 972; runtime 555 / 8957. Touched files: `eslint --no-inline-config` exit 0.
- **Full dogfood battery** (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, `(narrowing)` arm): exit 0 — Test Files 438 passed, 3 skipped (441); Tests 3622 passed, 41 skipped.
- **Derived gates** (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 118 families, each `CMD :: exit N` recorded before any pipe): 117 exit 0; `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` exit 3 = NOT MEASURED (its positive control is a pinned commit a shallow clone cannot reach; CI runs it). `--ran` reconciliation: `118 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 117 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED`.
- **The waiver-free gate**: `node scripts/check-stack-collection-maps.mjs` → `8 enumerations reconciled against 35 declared collections (16 waiver rows, each with a reason)`. Reverse verification: putting `'ragPipelines'` back into `APP_CATEGORY_KEYS` turns it red (`APP_CATEGORY_KEYS enumerates ragPipelines, which ObjectStackDefinitionSchema does not declare`), restored by byte copy.
- **Before/after census** (`git grep -n -i 'ragPipelines\|rag_pipeline'` outside CHANGELOGs and `docs/adr`): before, live rows in four registries plus four gate waivers; after, only code comments, the tests that pin the refusal, the `LIVE_TYPES` fixture of the mint-door suite (a legacy live set, like `theme`), the stack `guidance` prescription and the migration entries.
- **Fable review** (spec diff, independent agent): PASS, no must-fix; both should-fixes taken (the stack `guidance` prescription; the export-door consequence stated in the changeset and the semantic entry); incremental re-review PASS.
